title: Recovering signs and absorbing Pell quotients
claim: Each fixed polynomial has no zeros on its specified domain if and only if ZFC is syntactically consistent, by ordinary proofs formalizable in ZFC using the named inherited theorems.
proof_status: Ordinary mathematical proofs and finite arithmetic certificates; no new end-to-end kernel theorem or object-language ZFC derivation.

results.name: Q42
results.new_idea: A common-sign product guard and an even square root permit Pell index recovery to eliminate two separate positivity guards.

results.name: P14
results.new_idea: A positive square-root carrier absorbs the index quotient; a prior exclusion of first Pell index one prevents circular recovery.

results.name: F9
results.new_idea: Deflate a seventh-order radical majorant by the actual Pell parameter identity and certify the complete positive remainder.

operation_convention: One live binary addition, subtraction, or multiplication; fixed integer leaves and register reuse are free. This is not bit complexity.
